description: This file defines a React component 'DraftPersonaClient' for a Next.js app, managing the user interface and workflow for editing, saving, regenerating, and finalizing a draft persona. It includes types, state management, API interactions, and UI rendering logic.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string safely, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into an array of strings, filtering out falsy or non-string values.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Converts various input formats into a standardized array of CareerHighlightItem objects.

methods.name: looksLikePersonaDraftSchema
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object matches the PersonaDraftSchema shape.

methods.name: looksLikeLegacyDraft
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object matches the LegacyDraftPersona shape.

methods.name: toEditableModel
methods.description: Converts various draft JSON objects into a unified EditableDraftModel for editing.

methods.name: applyEditsToDraft
methods.description: Applies user edits to the original draft JSON, preserving structure based on detected schema.

methods.name: fetchLatestPersistedDraft
methods.description: Fetches the latest draft JSON from backend storage via API call.
